what: When a card enters the band excluding the bottom 170px of the screen, its inner image turns on from transparent with .2s cubic-bezier(.83,0,.17,1) — items entering at the same moment get numbers 1·2·3… and turn on 60ms later each, and the number resets to 1 on every scroll event, so each new row pops on from the left as you scroll down. Once on, it never hides again.

options.[data-fx-part=media]: Inner image to turn on (child) — the element itself if none
options.margin: Band (px) to subtract from the bottom of the screen, default 170
options.step · dur · ease: Stagger interval (sec, default .06) · on duration (sec, default .2) · curve (default .83,0,.17,1)
options.is-seen · is-in · is-done: Enters once · currently inside the band · ends after number × 80ms + 1s (so the consuming css can choose)
